educationCourses.title: Criminal Law & Tactical Enforcement
educationCourses.description: Master municipal statutes, custody procedures, and tactical apprehension. Required to serve as a sworn Police Officer.

examQuestions.question: What constitutes probable cause prior to detaining a suspect for store robbery?
options: Triggered perimeter alarms or eyewitness physical evidence

examQuestions.question: Which constitutional legal safeguard guarantees the right against self-incrimination upon arrest?
What is the standard procedure when a suspect attempts to escape on foot through an alleyway?
options: Deploy radio dispatch cordon and non-lethal apprehension

educationCourses.title: Emergency Trauma, Surgery & Pharmacology
educationCourses.description: Learn combat wound triage, surgical stitching, and critical pharmacology. Required to qualify as a Medical Doctor and operate private Clinics.

examQuestions.question: What is the immediate priority when treating an arterial hemorrhage from a knife wound?
options: Direct pressure dressing or tactical arterial tourniquet

examQuestions.question: Which pharmaceutical antagonist reverses life-threatening opioid respiratory depression?
What municipal license must be filed to admit hospital patients and perform trauma surgery?
options: City Hall Board of Health Clinical Deed

educationCourses.title: Culinary Arts & Nutritional Science
educationCourses.description: Study gastronomy, nutrition, food preservation, and kitchen logistics. Required to qualify as a Master Chef and open Restaurants/Bakeries.

examQuestions.question: What core benefit does high-protein tactical food provide to active street operatives?
options: Instant Energy regeneration and Happy morale recovery

examQuestions.question: What food safety protocol is required for high-volume commercial meal production?
options: Sterile food preservation and municipal sanitary health inspection
Storing raw meat at room temperature

examQuestions.question: What license tier allows a restaurant to produce up to 1,000 meals daily?

educationCourses.title: Sports Science & Fitness Management
educationCourses.description: Study biomechanics, resistance training, and facility operations. Required to open and operate private Gyms & Dojos.

examQuestions.question: What training regimen maximizes combat physical resilience and blunt impact absorption?
How do player-owned gym facilities generate sustainable commercial revenue?
options: Selling monthly gym memberships and custom training sets to other players

examQuestions.question: What is required to expand gym capacity beyond 500 members?
options: Upgraded Municipal Facility License & verified capital reserve

educationCourses.title: Corporate Finance & Franchise Management
educationCourses.description: Master commercial accounting, supply chains, and franchise tax structures. Required to register Corporations and Nightclubs.

examQuestions.question: How is net daily dividend calculated for a chartered commercial entity?
options: Gross receipts minus operational upkeep and worker payroll

examQuestions.question: What occurs if a registered business fails to maintain daily operational upkeep?
options: Municipal asset freeze and temporary operational shutdown

examQuestions.question: What is required to register a commercial charter at City Hall?
options: Accredited Business Exam certificate plus capital reserves in bank

educationCourses.title: Syndicate Logistics & Electronic Countermeasures
educationCourses.description: Study counter-surveillance, digital decrypters, and turf logistics. Unlocks Syndicate Captain rank and advanced heists.

examQuestions.question: What is the primary method to neutralize commercial store infrared sweep sensors?
options: Deploying electronic decrypters and moving through blind-spot intervals

examQuestions.question: Where should unlaundered heist revenue be stashed to prevent street muggings?
options: Inside your locked property reinforced safe vault
In an open wallet on the avenue

examQuestions.question: What role in an organized heist coordinates communication and police scanner alerts?
